title: Perceived Trustworthiness of Natural Language Generators

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative survey questions assessing participants' perceptions and beliefs on whether machine-generated texts are inherently gender-biased compared to human-produced texts.
Quantitative survey questions evaluating participants' perceptions of the cultural appropriateness of AI-generated text compared to human-authored text.
Survey questions asking participants whether they perceive performance disparities in machine translation tools across specific languages or language pairs.
Qualitative thematic analysis of open-ended survey responses identifying users' tendencies to over-rely on or uncritically trust natural language generation outputs.
